items.briefing:
A critical security vulnerability has been discovered in SonicWall SMA 1000 devices, allowing attackers to remotely access systems without needing a username or password. If your organisation uses this equipment, contact your IT support team immediately to check whether patches are available and apply them as a priority.

On a more positive note, Yubico has expanded its partnership with OpenAI to include Australia, bringing hardware-backed passkeys here as a stronger alternative to traditional passwords. This aligns with a growing push for more secure login methods across Australian organisations.

**Tip:** Ask your IT team whether any SonicWall devices are in use and confirm they have been patched.

featured.title: Yubico expands OpenAI partnership to Australia as hardware-backed passkey mandate begins
featured.summary: Yubico has expanded its partnership with OpenAI into Australia and nine other countries as OpenAI begins requiring hardware-backed passkeys…
